companyDescription: Psychedelic psychiatry · COMP360 psilocybin for treatment-resistant depression — two positive Phase 3s, final NDA submission due ~mid-Nov 2026 under rolling review; aiming for the first FDA-approved psilocybin therapy (1H27 launch target)
priceNote: Live $9.25 (+7.7%) on Nov 11, 2026. The 52-week range is $4.88–$15.87. Market cap is ~$1.3B. HC Wainwright reiterated Buy/$65 on Nov 9. Cash was ~$444M at Sep 30.
summary: This is a regulatory moonshot. On Nov 3, Compass said the final COMP360 NDA (TRD) would be filed "within two weeks" under rolling review, after two positive Phase 3s (COMP005, and COMP006 with 26-week durability out Jul 2026). Next come FDA filing acceptance (~60 days, ~mid-Jan 2027), any priority-review or voucher acceleration, and a 1H 2027 launch target as the first approved psilocybin therapy. Consensus is ~$23.75 (16 analysts, Strong Buy) and HCW is $65. Cash of $444M means no survival flag. regulatory_approval is a Tier-2 leader (+5.3pp vs +2.0 overall, n=8). Base +60% (~$14.8) is a filing-plus-acceptance re-rating over ~2–3 months, above the lane's realized 30d P75 (+12.2%; Base bias +72.7pp). แนะนำ 2–4% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้า FDA ปฏิเสธ (CRL) ลงได้ 50%+.

catalysts.name: Final COMP360 NDA submission (TRD)
catalysts.description: Rolling review is underway with sections already submitted. On Nov 3 management said the final submission would be filed within two weeks, so the expected window is ~Nov 17.

catalysts.name: FDA filing acceptance + review designation
catalysts.description: The 60-day filing decision (~mid-Jan 2027) sets the PDUFA date. Priority review or a national priority voucher could pull approval into 1H 2027.

risks: FDA could refuse to file or later issue a CRL. Functional unblinding, durability and REMS/monitoring design are known psychedelic review issues (Lykos MDMA CRL, 2024).
The effect size has disappointed before: CMPS fell ~36% on COMP005 in Jun 2025 despite hitting the primary endpoint.
Commercial model risk: in-clinic dosing with monitoring needs certified sites and a reimbursement path, so the launch ramp may be slow.
Warrant overhang and the likelihood of a raise around approval.
Timing slippage: "within two weeks" filings can slide, and the acceptance window could move PDUFA past 1H27.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: The Fed held at 3.75–4.00% on Oct 28. After the hot Oct CPI on Nov 10, CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~89–100%, with ~10% odds of 50bp. The 10-year is ~4.98%.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct CPI: headline +0.4% m/m, core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2% expected. Sep core PCE was 3.1% y/y. Oct PCE on Nov 25 is the next print, then Nov CPI on Dec 10, the day after FOMC.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Pre-commercial CNS biotech moving toward launch. Funded (~$444M), so rates matter through biotech multiples rather than financing needs.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — the regulatory clock is independent of the Fed, but the Dec 9 FOMC and Dec 10 CPI can knock small-cap biotech down between filing and acceptance. Use those dips.

entryStrategy.verdict: SPECULATIVE · Moonshot 3% max — two positive Phase 3s, a filing in days, a funded balance sheet and a Tier-2 leader catalyst type (regulatory_approval +5.3pp). The risk is FDA process, not data. Measured turbo at-catalyst median is -13.7% (n=19), so Entry 2 is preferred and Entry 1 is a starter only.

catalystSpot.preRunup: CMPS is already moving: +7.7% on Nov 11 with HCW reiterating $65. Filing news is largely expected, and the bigger re-rating historically comes at acceptance and approval.
catalystSpot.preRunupTiming: Into the filing PR (~Nov 17) and the 60-day acceptance

postWin.note: AXSM rose ~40% on the Auvelity (depression) approval after a long review (Aug 2022). SRPT closed +74% on the eteplirsen accelerated approval (Sep 2016). Novel-mechanism CNS approvals re-rate sharply when the market had priced in doubt.

postLose.note: CMPS itself fell ~36% on underwhelming COMP005 effect size (Jun 2025). A CRL or refuse-to-file would plausibly be -40–50% for a pre-commercial single-asset company.

spotSizing.reason: 3%. regulatory_approval is a Tier-2 leader (+5.3pp vs +2.0 overall, n=8; 2/8 windows had SPY down >2%), which supports the upper end of turbo sizing. The SELECTIVE macro tape and the lane-wide 4.9% hitRate cap it at 3%.

stopPreCatalyst.note: Wider than the turbo medianMAE (-24.1%). Below ~$6.90 the market doubts the filing or acceptance.

stopPostCatalyst.note: Refuse-to-file or a CRL means exit immediately. Do not average down into a resubmission cycle.

risks: FDA อาจไม่รับเรื่องหรือออก CRL ภายหลัง ประเด็นที่รู้กันในการรีวิวยาหลอนประสาทคือการปิดบังไม่ได้จริง ความทนทานของผล และการออกแบบ REMS/การติดตาม (Lykos MDMA ถูก CRL ปี 2024)
ขนาดผลเคยทำให้ผิดหวัง: CMPS ลง ~36% เมื่อผล COMP005 ออก มิ.ย. 2025 แม้จะผ่าน endpoint หลัก
ความเสี่ยงโมเดลธุรกิจ: การให้ยาในคลินิกพร้อมการติดตามต้องมีสถานที่ที่ได้รับรองและเส้นทางเบิกจ่าย การเปิดตลาดอาจช้า
แรงกดจาก warrant และมีโอกาสเพิ่มทุนช่วงได้รับอนุมัติ
เวลาอาจเลื่อน: การยื่น "ภายในสองสัปดาห์" อาจเลื่อนได้ และช่วงรับเรื่องอาจดัน PDUFA ออกไปเกินครึ่งแรกปี 2027
